A 1920s factory apprentice workshop: a grey-moustached master in a work apron shows two young Kazakh apprentices in flat caps how to operate a lathe, other apprentices at workbenches behind them, tall factory windows and rows of machines receding, mid shot.

Paper-cutout collage: flat silhouettes and textures cut from paper, visible paper grain and uneven hand-cut edges, layered depth, soft directional light and real shadows between the layers as in stop-motion animation. Not photorealistic, not painted. Palette: white and pale paper grounds, cool blue-grey and azure papers, deep petrol teal and mustard gold papers only as accents. Wide landscape composition; the left third stays calm, mostly plain pale paper, for a headline. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
